title: A gate is answered by its option number or its recommendation, not by the option text retyped
goal: answer ID GATE --option N answers with the Nth option of the gate and --recommended answers with the gate's recommendation, each recording what the equal --answer TEXT records; both refuse a number outside the options; a gate class that refuses a text answer refuses them the same

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P
T=os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py");r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
g=lambda *a:s.run(["git","-C",str(r),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
g("init","-q");(r/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items","scratch_dir":"_cache/scratch"}));(r/"items").mkdir()
def item(i,**k):
 d=dict(id=i,kind="story",title="t",status="todo",priority="P3",goal="g",touches=["x.txt"],checks=[{"run":["python3","-c","pass"]}]);d.update(k)
 (r/"items"/(i+".json")).write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+"\n")
def commit():g("add","-A");g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm","i")
env=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID="chk");env.pop("KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG",None)
def run(*a):return s.run([sys.executable,T,"--root",str(r),*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env)
item("ST-aaaaaaaa",gates=[{"id":"g1","kind":"provisional","question":"q","options":["a","b"],"recommendation":"b"}]);item("ST-bbbbbbbb",gates=[{"id":"g1","kind":"provisional","question":"q","options":["a","b"],"recommendation":"b"}]);item("ST-cccccccc",gates=[{"id":"g1","kind":"blocking","question":"q","options":["a","b"],"recommendation":"b"}]);commit()
a=run("answer","ST-aaaaaaaa","g1","--recommended","--provisional");b=run("answer","ST-bbbbbbbb","g1","--option","1","--provisional")
c=run("answer","ST-aaaaaaaa","g1","--option","3","--provisional");d=run("answer","ST-cccccccc","g1","--recommended","--provisional")
got=lambda i:json.loads((r/"items"/(i+".json")).read_text())["gates"][0].get("answer")
print(a.returncode,b.returncode,c.returncode,d.returncode,(a.stdout+a.stderr)[-150:])
ok=a.returncode==0 and b.returncode==0 and c.returncode!=0 and d.returncode!=0
sys.exit(0 if ok and got("ST-aaaaaaaa")=="b" and got("ST-bbbbbbbb")=="a" and got("ST-cccccccc") is None else 1)

clauses.clause: answer ID GATE --option N answers with the Nth option of the gate and --recommended answers with the gate's recommendation, each recording what the equal --answer TEXT records
both refuse a number outside the options
a gate class that refuses a text answer refuses them the same

gates.question: How does --option N count, and may --option or --recommended go with --provisional?
options: N counts from 1, and with --provisional they record the agent's answer
N counts from 0, and --provisional ignores them
gates.recommendation: N counts from 1, and with --provisional they record the agent's answer
gates.reason: because the item's check passes --option 1 --provisional and the options are shown to people as a numbered list
gates.answer: N counts from 1, and with --provisional they record the agent's answer

notes: From the 2026-10-24 telemetry and query-log analysis: 624 backlog.py answer calls in 146 sessions: 294 '--answer "<option text>" --by operator', 186 '--confirm --by operator' (the second call of the provisional flow), 93 '--provisional'; 256 orchestrating turns had an answer as their only call, with 107K output tokens in them. A runner loop was written by hand to read each gate's recommendation and pass it back as --answer. answer takes only the option's exact text (bl_items.py:429), so a retyped text that differs by a character is refused and costs another turn. Saves about 200 turns, about 100K output tokens and about 10 USD a week (estimate). Medium confidence. Gate handling stays the operator's: the change removes retyping, not the authority (the same --by rules, no new right to answer). Different from ST-ecohnugl (answer warns on a pick other than the recommendation) and ST-tvnxvfjp (relayed answers need --free). Lane: parked sprint-orchestration class, EP-gzr4mmkm. Run 2026-10-25 (unattended, SP-f7kaebel): sprint start gate approved by operator; item turned todo at start. Gate g1 (agents-rule) answered with its recommendation (pre-approved by the operator for the 2026-10-25 run).
